metadata.description: Bootstrap shim for the event4u agent-config suite. This plugin ships ONLY the dispatcher hooks plus one install-pointer skill — ALL content (skills, rules, commands) is installed via `npx -y @event4u/agent-config init`, which writes the file projection AND registers the same hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. DEPRECATED as a content channel; kept so the marketplace listing stays discoverable. Its hooks run only alongside a global npm install of the package (`npx -y @event4u/agent-config init` or `npm i -g`); a project-local install is never used. On a plugin-only install no dispatcher is reachable, no hook runs, and the fail_closed guards (block-no-verify, block-kernel-rule-writes, block-plumbing-writes) are OFF — only the session start says so.

plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: Bootstrap shim — hooks + install pointer only. Install the full suite with `npx -y @event4u/agent-config init`; this plugin intentionally contains no content skills.
